candidates.name: Energy Transfer Abilene data center laterals (three laterals to the Oracle/Crusoe Abilene campus)
candidates.from: Energy Transfer North Texas pipeline network / Hugh Brinson Pipeline
candidates.to: Oracle Abilene, Texas data center campus
candidates.status_guess: operating (first lateral); two more under construction, due mid-2026

evidence.note: Energy Transfer began gas deliveries to the Abilene data center through the first of three laterals tied to its North Texas network. Two more laterals were expected by mid-2026. Supply from Hugh Brinson and North Texas pipelines. Length not stated.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not on the roster: P3885 Hugh Brinson is the long-haul trunk, not the campus laterals. Length unknown (a secondary tracker mentions about 14 miles for one lateral, not verified).

candidates.name: Fermi America Amarillo HyperGrid lateral (Energy Transfer)
candidates.from: Energy Transfer pipeline just south of the Fermi campus, Amarillo area
candidates.to: Fermi America HyperGrid data center campus, Amarillo, Texas

evidence.note: The HyperGrid project will require a new lateral but no major new long-haul infrastructure; tie-in to Energy Transfer supply.
Fermi secured a gas pipeline connection from Energy Transfer for its Amarillo campus.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for an Amarillo or Fermi lateral. Length unknown.

candidates.name: GW Ranch dual gas pipeline connections (Pecos County)
aka: Pacifico GW Ranch gas supply lines
candidates.to: GW Ranch data center and gas power campus, Pecos County, Texas

evidence.note: GW Ranch design includes dual gas pipeline connections for up to 5 GW of gas-fired power for data centers.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row; weak lead, operator, route and length unknown. May overlap P5664 Saguaro Connector only by region (not confirmed).

candidates.name: Green Chile Pipeline (Project Jupiter lateral)
candidates.from: El Paso Natural Gas interconnect, Dona Ana County NM
candidates.to: Project Jupiter data center gas plants, Dona Ana County NM

evidence.note: Part of a roughly 17-mile gas pipeline to serve the Project Jupiter data center; state trust land right-of-way denied again July 2026. Other reports say 17.7 miles, 24-inch, BLM authorized May 2026.

candidates.why_maybe_new: EXISTING_ROW P8290 Transwestern Green Chile Project: DataCenter tag lead, not a new row.
